observation.command:
cd /workspace
# Wait for compose up --wait to finish (it blocks until healthy)
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  if [ -f /tmp/compose-up.done ]; then break; fi
  sleep 5
done
echo "=== compose-up.done ==="; cat /tmp/compose-up.done 2>/dev/null || echo "(still waiting)"
echo "=== compose up log tail ==="; tail -20 /tmp/compose-up.log
echo "=== container status ==="; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}"
